mods.name: My Mod
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: An empty mod to start from: a manifest, a script that says hello, and the folders a mod can have.

mods.name: Example Ores
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: An ore that generates underground, the gem it drops, a block of it, tools, armour and recipes - using the game's own textures.

mods.name: Example Biome Features
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: Trees, flowers, a structure and ore deposits that only appear in certain biomes.

mods.name: Example Blocks
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: Decorative blocks: shapes (slab, pillar, carpet, a pixel box), a light, an icy tile, a falling block and a block model that turns to face you.

mods.name: Example Items
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: Food with effects, a throwable pebble, a slingshot that fires it, and a wand whose script tells you what a block is.

mods.name: Example Creature
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: A creature: a Bedrock model (as Blockbench exports it), how it behaves, where it spawns, what it drops, a spawn egg - and a script that hears it.

mods.name: Example Structures
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: A ruin built into new land, its chest filled from a loot table, and a command that builds it where you stand.

mods.name: Example Scripting
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: Commands, a menu with buttons and an item picker, a key players can rebind (Options > Controls), a HUD line and data saved with the world.

mods.name: Example Texture Pack
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: Changes how things look, sound and read: textures, a sound and names - here swapping some of the game's own pictures around.

mods.name: Example Rules
mods.author: Minecraft RE
mods.description: Rules the game enforces at once: creepers don't break blocks, no fall damage - and a command that protects the area around you.
